GettingStartedGuide, the Garmin route's first step: the Connect IQ store's own listing title, pinned in docs/copy/phrases.json as ciqListingTitle. A rider searches the store for the name letter by letter, so the brackets are part of it and not an aside.
Onboarding/WelcomeView: SVG path data for the drawn wordmark. It is geometry in a string literal, not a sentence, so its length says nothing about the voice.

Branding.callToAction, the lockup under the wordmark on every card that leaves the phone. web/js/cardstats.js composes the same line from the same two parts and web/tools/verify_copy.py holds the two character for character, so the dash is part of a cross-platform mark rather than punctuation in a sentence.

ShareCard's uncertified disclaimer. web/js/cardstats.js prints the same string and web/tools/card_parity.mjs compares the two card stat blocks string by string, so the dash cannot move on one platform alone.
FeedbackReport's device table: Apple's own marketing name for that phone, printed in a diagnostic mail so a report names the device the way Apple does. It is data, not a sentence.
